reasoning: Patch closes the empty-response bug by serving a deterministic prompt-template artifact for supported commands.
It preserves mandatory deterministic verification: substitution runs after staged.observe and after verify+approval have already passed.
It preserves accepted-state-only commits: _strict_commit remains reachable only after passed==True and approved==True.
It does NOT bypass FictionGraph checks: staged.observe runs on the substituted text and contradictions still gate the commit.
It handles unsupported/malformed/compound/injection-shaped commands safely: unsupported commands return UNSUPPORTED and are not substituted.

It had two provenance/labeling gaps in the first landing: (A) serve_path stayed GENERATED_VERIFIED even when served text was template; (B) candidate_sha256 was recomputed on substituted text so persisted digest matched template text, not original generator candidate.
fixes_applied: When bridge_verifier_artifact is True, set candidate['serve_path'] = 'PROMPT_TEMPLATE_VERIFIED' and candidate['served_by'] = 'bridge_verifier_artifact'.
Record candidate['generator_sha256'] BEFORE substitution so the original generator candidate digest is preserved separately from the committed template-served artifact digest.
